prompt: I need a new service function to fetch acquisition reward history from the contract (query msg: { get_reward_history: { user } }) and a corresponding React hook. Follow the existing patterns in the codebase.

assertions.text: Service returns null on error (not throwing)
Service has mock data fallback with USE_MOCK_DATA flag and simulated delay
Service validates client for null before querying
Hook includes appState.rpcUrl in query key for multi-chain cache separation
Hook has appropriate staleTime set (not relying on defaults)
Hook has enabled gate to prevent premature fetching
